name: Flora
tagline: Ready-made website for florists and flower studios
description: Flora is a website template for florists and flower studios, with a centred logo between two halves of the menu, a hero collage of bouquet prints on a sage field, occasion tiles with clear prices, a bouquet of the day, a bouquet composer that suggests three bouquets by occasion, colour and budget, a same-day delivery map with zone prices, wedding packages with a quote form and an office subscription. Raspberry rose, sage and cream with the Spectral serif give the website a warm, handmade character. Replace the copy, photos, prices, delivery zones and reviews with your own before publishing.
features: Hero collage of bouquet prints with same-day delivery cut-off
Occasion tiles with prices: birthdays, love, sympathy and business
Bouquet of the day with flowers, price and availability
Bouquet composer: occasion, colour and budget, with three matching bouquets
Delivery map with zone prices and time windows
Wedding packages with a quote request form
Client reviews, to be replaced with genuine testimonials
Order form that the composer fills in
